claims.text: A study of 306 practitioners and 20 in-depth case studies across 26 domains found that 68% of production agents execute at most 10 steps before requiring human intervention.
The same study found 70% of production agents rely on prompting off-the-shelf models rather than weight tuning, and 74% depend primarily on human evaluation.

Allianz's Project Nemo, launched in Australia in July 2025 and deployed in under 100 days, uses seven specialised agents for low-complexity food-spoilage claims; the workflow runs in under five minutes, then a human claims professional reviews the audit summary and authorises payout, cutting processing and settlement time 80%.

Allianz Partners with Taktile deployed modular specialised agents in a sequential claims system, lifting straight-through processing 30% in a six-month production pilot, with human experts kept in the loop on every decision and high-risk claims routed to specialists.

Mediahuis is testing a custom-built newsroom agent pipeline in which agents commission stories from a curated database of verified sources, draft text, select images, fact-check and review legally, with a human editor reviewing before publication.

Zalando uses a 'product truth' engine as an AI quality-assurance layer that compares generated content against original product imagery for colour, construction and brand marks and flags altered details, leaving creative teams to judge brand fit.

WPP Open is an agentic marketing platform connecting strategy, creative, media and production with hundreds of verified agents; WPP reports a global technology brand cut strategy and creative development from four weeks to three hours and Hawkstone achieved 33x content volume.
WPP Open is built on a $400 million, five-year Google partnership using Gemini, Vertex AI, Veo, Imagen and Google DeepMind.

JAKALA runs a hybrid agent model on the Claude Agent SDK that cut campaign-optimisation cycles from 5-7 working days to under 24 hours and raised team productivity about 30%, with 3,000+ Claude seats.

Salesforce's own Agentforce SDR agent worked more than 43,000 leads and generated $1.7 million in pipeline from dormant leads, while its service agent handled over 1.4 million conversations and the company says it took about $100 million of support cost out.
At Wipro, Ema's AI employee serves 240,000+ associates across 65 countries, handling about 2.9 million queries a year across 100+ workflows and eliminating about 60% of tickets.
Ema uses EmaFusion to route tasks across more than 100 AI models and a no-code Generative Workflow Engine, with 50+ prebuilt AI employees and 250+ integrations.
Hypatos claims 85-92% straight-through processing for accounts payable in mixed-document enterprise environments, higher than RPA or traditional IDP-plus-workflow approaches.

A Hypatos fashion-retail case covering about 800,000 invoices a year across 70+ markets reports roughly a 40% reduction in FTE requirements, with the customer's centre of excellence taking over configuration after a five-wave rollout.
UiPath's Johnson Controls case reports 200,000 monthly AP transactions automated, vendor costs cut 75%, and $6 million saved in accounts payable.

In mortgage lending, Vesta starts lenders with a human approving each agent step and then graduates to shared autonomy, logging every action and its reasoning, with the lender remaining responsible for underwriting decisions.

CrewAI production lessons: agents that work alone fail when composed, unbounded tool loops grow costs exponentially, and tiered model selection (frontier models for reasoning, cheap models for extraction) cut per-document cost 40-60% without measurable quality loss on routine documents.
CrewAI reports executing over 10 million agents in 30 days and uses its own stack for marketing content generation and lead qualification, which generated 15+ customer calls in two weeks.
Unilever's content studios operate under 'Brand DNAi' governance for brand-safe content, yet Unilever reports no company-wide AI return despite 330+ active AI projects.
Aggregated analyses put annual AI SDR churn at 50-70%, and reply rates of 0.5-1.5% for autonomous sending versus 4-8% for human-in-the-loop configurations.

TechCrunch reporting found former 11x employees describing 70-80% attrition among early customers, with about $14 million reported ARR but only about $3 million in contracts surviving three-month break clauses.
Gartner predicts over 40% of agentic AI projects will be cancelled by the end of 2027 and warns of 'agent washing', estimating only about 130 of thousands of agentic vendors are real.
Roughly 72% of enterprises run agents in production while only about 21% have a mature governance model; KPMG's Agent 365 deployment is positioned as a central registry for governing agents.
Decagon uses a supervisor model that checks for hallucinations before responses reach customers, and its own blog acknowledges high deflection rates can hide customer rage and brand damage.
